// EXPECT OK
// Three levels of nesting

struct Level1 {
    int a;
};

struct Level2 {
    struct Level1 l1;
    int b;
};

struct Level3 {
    struct Level2 l2;
    int c;
};

int main(void) {

    l3.l2.l1.a = 1;
    l3.l2.b = 2;
    l3.c = 3;
    return l3.l2.l1.a + l3.l2.b + l3.c;
}

// Struct with large array field

struct Large {
    int arr[10];
};

int main(void) {

    i = 0;

    }

// Complex nested struct with arrays

struct Inner {
    int arr[2];
    int value;
};

struct Middle {
    struct Inner inner;
    int arr[3];
};

struct Outer {
    struct Middle middle;
    int base;
};

int main(void) {
    struct Outer o;
    o.middle.inner.arr[0] = 1;
    o.middle.inner.arr[1] = 2;
    o.middle.inner.value = 3;
    o.middle.arr[0] = 4;
    o.middle.arr[1] = 5;
    o.middle.arr[2] = 6;
    o.base = 7;
    return o.middle.inner.arr[0] + o.middle.inner.value + o.middle.arr[2] + o.base;
}

; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if b == 0, return 0
L3                              ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L4               ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1

        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L5               ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L5                              ; skip negate b

        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L6                              ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0

        CMP R3, %D 0

        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L8                              ; skip add

        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L6                   ; continue loop
L7                              ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L9                ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L9                   ; result ready
L2                              ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L9                              ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L6                   ; continue loop
L7                              ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L9                ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L9                   ; result ready
L2                              ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L9                              ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

// Mix of global and local struct variables

struct Point {
    int x;
    int y;
};

struct Point global;

int main(void) {
    struct Point local;
    global.x = 10;
    global.y = 20;
    local.x = 30;

// Nested struct assignment

struct Inner {
    int value;
};

struct Outer {
    struct Inner inner;
    int y;
};

int main(void) {

    struct Outer o2;
    o1.inner.value = 42;
    o1.y = 10;
    o2 = o1;  // Copy entire struct
    return o2.inner.value + o2.y;
}

; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps

        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1

L7                              ; loop done, apply sign

        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L9                ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0

L2                              ; zero multiplier

// EXPECT OK
// Comprehensive test: nested structs, arrays, assignments, function calls

struct Inner {
    int arr[2];
    int value;
};

struct Outer {
    struct Inner inner;
    int base;
};

int compute(struct Outer o) {
    return o.inner.arr[0] + o.inner.arr[1] + o.inner.value + o.base;
}

int main(void) {
    struct Outer o1;
    struct Outer o2;
    o1.inner.arr[0] = 1;
    o1.inner.arr[1] = 2;
    o1.inner.value = 3;
    o1.base = 4;
    o2 = o1;  // Copy struct
    return compute(o2);
}

        CALL F_MUL              ; call multiplication helper

; Helper functions for multiplication and division

F_MUL                           ; Helper function: int mul(int a, int b)
; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if b == 0, return 0
L3                              ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L4               ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L4                              ; skip negate a
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L5               ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L5                              ; skip negate b
; Binary shift-and-add multiplication (Russian peasant algorithm)
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign flag on stack
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L6                              ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L7                ; if b == 0, exit loop
        AND R1, %D 1, R3        ; R3 = b & 1
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_EQ L8                ; if (b & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L8                              ; skip add
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; a <<= 1
        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L6                   ; continue loop
L7                              ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L9                ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L9                   ; result ready
L2                              ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L9                              ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

// EXPECT OK

// Comprehensive test: nested structs, arrays, assignments, function calls

struct Inner {
    int arr[2];
    int value;
};

struct Outer {
    struct Inner inner;
    int base;
};

int compute(struct Outer o) {
    return o.inner.arr[0] + o.inner.arr[1] + o.inner.value + o.base;
}

int main(void) {
    struct Outer o1;
    struct Outer o2;
    o1.inner.arr[0] = 1;
    o1.inner.arr[1] = 2;
    o1.inner.value = 3;
    o1.base = 4;
    o2 = o1;  // Copy struct
    return compute(o2);
}

// Complex nested struct with arrays

struct Inner {
    int arr[2];
    int value;
};

struct Middle {

    int arr[3];

struct Outer {

}
